description: This file defines the RouteProviderLazyBuilder class, which acts as a front-end for route provision in Drupal, implementing lazy loading and event subscription for route rebuilding.

classes.name: RouteProviderLazyBuilder
classes.description: A class that provides a lazy-loading front-end for Drupal route provider, implementing event subscription and route rebuilding logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with route provider and builder services.

methods.name: getRouteProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the real route provider, rebuilding routes if necessary.

methods.name: getRouteCollectionForRequest
methods.description: Returns route collection for a given request.

methods.name: getRouteByName
methods.description: Returns a route by its name.

methods.name: getRoutesByNames
methods.description: Returns multiple routes by their names.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the route provider, avoiding recursive rebuilds.

methods.name: hasRebuilt
methods.description: Checks if the router has been rebuilt.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns events the class subscribes to for route rebuilding.

methods.name: routerRebuilding
methods.description: Sets rebuilding flag to true during route rebuild.

methods.name: routerRebuildFinished
methods.description: Marks the route rebuild as finished and updates flags.

methods.name: getRouteAliases
methods.description: Returns route aliases for a given route name.
